raw_text:
Arjun Kumar
arjun.kumar.android@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx09 | github.com/arjunkumar | Bengaluru
SUMMARY
Android developer with experience building mobile apps in Kotlin. Has integrated REST APIs into mobile apps but
has not built web frontends or Node.js backends.
EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science, MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.3/10
SKILLS
Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, REST API integration (Retrofit), Firebase, SQLite, Git, basic Python
PROJECTS
Campus Food Ordering App (Android)
•
Built a native Android app in Kotlin, integrated with a Firebase backend
•
Used Retrofit to consume REST APIs for menu and order data
Habit Tracker App
•
Android app with local SQLite storage and Firebase authentication
CERTIFICATIONS
Android Developer Nanodegree (partial, Udacity)
